verdict.rationale: Kong documents logging and monitoring plugins for gateway traffic (kong-gh-3). OpenTelemetry metric export and request logging are documented, but only for AI, MCP, and A2A traffic (kong-docs-61, kong-docs-58, kong-docs-69); MCP observability and analytics are also claimed (kong-gh-6, kong-gh-19). Coverage for general API traffic is only a one-line claim. missing for 10: named metrics integrations (e.g. Prometheus/Datadog) for general API traffic, distributed tracing support for non-AI traffic, in-depth logging plugin docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
